question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dainty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inelegant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dainty"** means something that is delicately small and pretty; it often refers to something that is elegant and refined in appearance. (नाज़ुक)

 
 
• **Example: **She picked up the dainty teacup with her fingers.
 
 
 
• **"Inelegant" **refers to something that lacks grace or refinement; it is clumsy or awkward in appearance or manner. (अशिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **His inelegant dance moves were the talk of the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dainty' **is **'inelegant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Inelegant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Timid **(डरपोक): Lacking in courage or confidence.

 
 
• **Example:** The timid child was hesitant to speak in front of the class.
 
 
 
• **Critical **(आलोचनात्मक): Expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments.
 
 
• **Example: **The critical review of the movie made the director upset.
 
 
 
• **Demanding** (मांग करनेवाला): Requiring much effort or attention.
 
 
• **Example:** The demanding job left her with little free time.
 
 

36:Tb8a,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.</p&
